ja.summary: この号のタイムライン作成者: Tcho_tcho 1931 年、顧俊章の反乱により、上海の地下システムは壊滅的な打撃を受けました。陳雲は特別支部の再建と地下作業システム全体の再構築を主導した。レッドチームは、裏切り者の摘発、内部関係者への仕向け、世論の救済など、さまざまな方法で攻撃を行った。亡命した顧俊章は国民党に特務技術一式を輸出し、「細胞政策」は党組織を内部から腐食させた。牛蘭の救出と呉昊の噂の反論から、市内での多数の騒動、主要メンバーの逮捕と反乱に至るまで、双方は絶えず勝利と敗北を交換した。敵と我が勢力の引き離しを繰り返す上海で、生と死の一歩一歩の裏には、名もなき人物の生涯を賭けた決断があった。

en.title: Shanghai Spy War Chronicles Issue 8丨No regrets for making a move
en.summary: Timeline of this issue produced by: Tcho_tcho In 1931, Gu Shunzhang rebelled, and Shanghai’s underground system suffered a devastating blow. Chen Yun took the lead in rebuilding the Special Branch and reconstructing the entire underground work system. The Red Team attacked in many ways, including picking out traitors, planting insiders, and public opinion rescue. Gu Shunzhang, who had defected, exported a full set of secret service techniques to the Kuomintang, and the "cell policy" corroded the party organization from within. From Niu Lan's rescue and Wu Hao's refutation of rumors, to numerous bust-ups in the city, and key members being arrested and rebelling one after another, the two sides constantly exchanged victory and defeat. In Shanghai, where the forces of the enemy and ourselves are repeatedly pulled apart, behind every step of life and death is the nameless person's decision to risk all his life.

ja.title: Touch Le Night Talk: KTV の二次元
ja.summary: Tu Le は夜に、くだらない話、幽霊の話、ゲームに関する新しいことなどを毎日話します。ミッキー弁護士が欲しい！ （写真／ロナウジーニョ） 先週末、友達と待ちに待ったピュアKの試合をしました。いつから始まったのか分かりません。このグループの二次元活動が始まり、最終的には必ず「純Kはどうだ」という決め台詞が発動した。日曜日の午後、私たちは時間通りに Pure K に到着しました。真ん中の席は4人で座っても十分でした。席に着くとすぐに、全員がゴールに直行しました。QR コードをスキャンして曲を注文する人もいれば、QR コードをスキャンして食べ物を注文する人もいます。 1曲の時間の中で、メニューが何回もスクロールされていました。数年前、「台湾料理はピュアKの正統派」という言葉が流行った。ここのビーフスティックは私の必需品でした。今回戻ってきたら、残念ながら棚から撤去されていました。その喪失感は、ベテランプレイヤーが戻ってきて、自分が時代に見捨てられ、自分を育ててくれた車椅子のキャラクターが下水道に落ちてしまったことに似ている。タブレットを何度かスクラッチしたりスクロールしたりして、それが単なる感情の問題であることを頭で理解しました。

en.title: Touch Le Night Talk: The Second Dimension in KTV
en.summary: Tu Le talks at night, talking nonsense, ghost things, and new things related to games every day. I want Lawyer Mickey! (Photo / Ronaldinho) Last weekend, I had a long-awaited pure K game with my friends. I don’t know when it started. This group of two-dimensional activities started, and in the end they always triggered the fixed line "How about pure K". On Sunday afternoon, we arrived at Pure K on time. The middle seat was more than enough for four people. As soon as we sat down, everyone went straight to the goal: some people were scanning the QR code to order songs, and some were scanning the QR code to order food. In the time of one song, the menu had been scrolled several times. A few years ago, there was a popular saying that "Taiwanese cuisine is orthodox in Pure K." Its beef sticks used to be my must-order. This time I came back and found that it has been sadly removed from the shelves. The feeling of loss is like a veteran player returning to find that he has been abandoned by the times, and the wheelchair character who brought him up has gone into the sewer. I scratched and scrolled on the tablet several times, and I understood intellectually that it was just a matter of emotion.

In order to concentrate on fishing, Zeshuk turned off his mobile phone. Later that day, Zeshuk returned to his vacation cabin from the river to find a stream of text messages pouring into his phone. "I received almost 10 text messages," Zeshuk said. "As soon as I turned on my phone, I saw someone sending me a message to express condolences: 'I am deeply sorry for what happened to BioWare.' My first reaction at the time was: 'BioWare is gone!'" A recent photo of Greg Zeshuk In 1995, Zeshuk co-founded BioWare with Ray Muzica and Augustine Ye. Over the past 30 years, BioWare has created many highly regarded games such as "Baldur's Gate", "Mass Effect" and "Dragon Age", and even redefined role-playing.
